title: A posterior EEG sleep-condition-by-eye-state interaction remains negative under participant-level sign-flip inference
abstract: A computational robustness re-analysis of released derived spectra from OpenNeuro ds004902 found an order-balanced posterior theta/alpha interaction of -3.509 dB (stratified bootstrap 95% interval -5.466 to -1.484 dB; participant-level sign-flip p=0.00130). The scope is association in stored recordings, not a causal effect or independent empirical replication.

citations.reason: Uses released derivatives and independently tests robustness of the exact reported interaction.
